purpose: Immutable value object that describes the full migration history for one PostgreSQL table as an ordered list of versioned Transitions.
businessRules: Each TransitionPlan belongs to exactly one table, identified by tableName.
Transitions are declared with fromVersions (list of acceptable source versions), toVersion, and the SQL statements to execute.
fromVersions uses List.of(-1) to represent 'table not yet created' (matching the Haskell euler-lsp convention of version -1 for absent tables).
Transitions must be declared in ascending toVersion order.
